```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(meta)
library(metafor)
library(metadat)
library(haven)
library(writexl)
library(openxlsx)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(readxl)
options(scipen = 999)
```


```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
appliancesmarketshare <- read_xlsx("appliances_marketshare.xlsx", sheet = "Appliances")
appliancesmarketshare$z_value <- as.numeric(appliancesmarketshare$z_value)
appliancesmarketshare$z_value <- ifelse(appliancesmarketshare$effect_direction == "decrease",
                                   -appliancesmarketshare$z_value,
                                   appliancesmarketshare$z_value)
appliancesmarketshare$z_variance <- as.numeric(appliancesmarketshare$z_variance)
```

```{r}
summary(appliancesmarketshare)
```

```{r}
## Subset dataset for each appliance and intervention in marketshare
## We want to regroup by interventions and then only arrange by appliance
## rebate, tax_credit, subsidy, loan can be grouped into monetary ? 
data_marketshare <- appliancesmarketshare %>% 
              mutate(Intervention = case_when(feedback == 1 ~ "Feedback",
                                              information == 1 ~ "Information",
                                              label == 1 ~ "Label",
                                              rebate == 1 ~ "Rebate",
                                              tax_credit == 1 ~ "Tax",
                                              subsidy == 1 ~ "Subsidy",
                                              loan == 1 ~ "Loan",
                                              choice_architecture == 1 ~ "Choice Architecture"))

data_marketshare_washing <- data_marketshare %>% 
                  filter(washing_machine == 1)

data_marketshare_dryer <- data_marketshare %>% 
                  filter(clothes_dryer == 1)

data_marketshare_dishwasher <- data_marketshare %>% 
                  filter(diswasher == 1)

data_marketshare_refrigerator <- data_marketshare %>% 
                  filter(refrigerator == 1)

data_marketshare_heat_pump <- data_marketshare %>% 
                  filter(heat_pump == 1)

data_marketshare_lighting <- data_marketshare %>% 
                  filter(lighting == 1)

data_marketshare_water <- data_marketshare %>% 
                  filter(water_heater == 1)

data_marketshare_ac <- data_marketshare %>% 
                  filter(ac == 1)

data_marketshare_tv <- data_marketshare %>% 
                  filter(tv == 1)
```

```{r}
### RANDOM EFFECTS MODEL ###
##washing machine
m.gen_marketshare_washing <- metagen(TE = z_value,
                 seTE = z_variance,
                 data = data_marketshare_washing,
                 studlab = authors,
                 sm = "ZCOR",
                 fixed = FALSE,
                 random = TRUE,
                 backtransf = F,
                 )

## forest plot of marketshare

png(file = "forestplot_washing_random.png", width = 6000, height = 3000, res = 500)
forest.meta(m.gen_marketshare_washing,
           leftcols = c("authors", "Intervention"),
           digits =6,
           col.random = "Red",
           xlab = "Effect Sizes",
           col.square = "Blue")

### FIXED EFFECTS MODEL ###
  
m1.gen_marketshare_washing <- metagen(TE = z_value,
                 seTE = z_variance,
                 data = data_marketshare_washing,
                 studlab = authors,
                 sm = "ZCOR",
                 fixed = TRUE,
                 random = FALSE,
                 backtransf = F,
                 )

## forest plot of marketshare

png(file = "forestplot_washing_fixed.png", width = 6000, height = 3000, res = 500)
forest.meta(m1.gen_marketshare_washing,
           leftcols = c("authors", "Intervention"),
           digits =6,
           col.random = "Red",
           xlab = "Effect Sizes",
           col.square = "Blue")       
```
